description: Check which Apple services (Apple Music, iCloud Calendar, Contacts, Mail, Apple Maps, WeatherKit, iTunes) are configured and reachable. For each: whether credentials are set (and which variables to set if not), and whether Apple accepted them on a cheap read-only request. Also reports the write mode and display time zone. Run this first when a tool fails or to see what this server can do.

services.description: Only check these services (default: every enabled service).

name: apple_healthcheck
title: Check Apple service credentials and connectivity
